data.one_liner: UI library and widget set inspired by old retro video game consoles.
data.what_it_does: Nes UI provides a complete set of retro-styled widgets like buttons, checkboxes, containers, and dialogs. It includes a custom ThemeData and integrates with Google Fonts to deliver an 8-bit video game aesthetic.
use_when: You are building a game UI or a retro-themed application in Flutter.
You want custom pixel-art styled widgets like NesButton, NesContainer, and NesConfirmDialog.
avoid_when: You require standard Material or Cupertino look and feel.
You want a heavy focus on animations or physics-based motion without retro styling.
strengths: Distinct retro video game aesthetic out of the box.
Custom widgets designed specifically for retro game layouts and menus.
weaknesses: Limited to a very specific retro visual style.
Font loading via Google Fonts requires internet access at runtime unless bundled manually.
data.setup_notes: Call WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() at the main method and add the flutterNesTheme() to your MaterialApp.
